design_philosophy: Trustworthy, professional, and accessible for semi-urban/rural Indian field officers. The app must feel like a stable, high-end fintech product (like CRED or Jupiter) but grounded in utility. Uses clear bilingual (English/Hindi) typography, high contrast for outdoor visibility, and generous touch targets.

fonts.body: 'IBM Plex Sans Devanagari', 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground

rules: No generic sans for headings. Use Outfit for English, Hind for Hindi.
Use IBM Plex Sans Devanagari globally for body text to ensure seamless bilingual rendering.
Bilingual UI pattern: English primary label, smaller Hindi secondary label (e.g., 'First Name / प्रथम नाम' where Hindi is muted-foreground).

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Mobile-first, generous thumb zones. Everything must be easily tappable on a cheap Android device in bright sunlight.
spacing_and_layout.container: w-full mx-auto max-w-7xl px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6
spacing_and_layout.touch_targets: min-h-[3.5rem] (h-14) for all buttons and inputs. Crucial for field officers.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: MODE B: The 'Control Room' Grid for Dashboards. Stacked full-width cards for mobile. Use tight gaps (gap-4).
spacing_and_layout.corners: rounded-xl for cards, rounded-lg for buttons to keep it professional.
spacing_and_layout.surfaces: Flat Solid surfaces with 1px border (border-border). Avoid glassmorphism for field apps to ensure max outdoor legibility.

forms.inputs: Shadcn UI Input, height h-14, solid bg-white border border-border focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary. High contrast text.
forms.labels: Clear bold labels, text-sm mb-2 text-foreground flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:gap-1

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground h-14 rounded-lg font-semibold hover:bg-primary/90 transition-colors shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-muted text-foreground h-14 rounded-lg font-semibold hover:bg-muted/80 border border-border

cards.default: bg-card text-card-foreground p-6 border border-border rounded-xl shadow-sm
cards.client_list_item: bg-card p-4 border-b border-border/50 flex flex-col gap-2 hover:bg-muted/30 cursor-pointer transition-colors

camera_gps.placeholder: bg-muted/30 border-2 border-dashed border-border rounded-xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-8 text-muted-foreground gap-4 w-full aspect-video

motion.interactions: Buttons MUST have hover and active states (scale down slightly active:scale-[0.98]).
motion.loaders: Use clean spinner or pulse animations for OCR extraction and GPS location fetching to build trust during wait times.

icons.rules: Use for clear signposting (e.g., Camera icon for uploads, MapPin for GPS). Maintain consistent stroke width.

image_urls.description: Man in traditional indian attire talking on phone. Use for Login Page background or Hero visual to establish local context.
Elderly woman selling flowers and fruit. Perfect for 'Client Profiles' empty state or dashboard banner.
Abstract pattern of light and shadow. Use as subtle background texture for the KYC form header.
A street vendor in Jaipur. Good for Guarantor/Co-borrower contextual imagery or marketing sidebars.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio against backgrounds. Use deep green text on light green backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: All form inputs and buttons MUST have focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2 focus:outline-none.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements must include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='submit-kyc-button').

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Update Tailwind CSS configuration to include the custom colors listed above using CSS variables in index.css.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Import 'Outfit', 'Hind', and 'IBM Plex Sans Devanagari' from Google Fonts in index.css.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Build mobile-first. Default everything to w-full. Use bottom sticky navigation on mobile and a sidebar on desktop.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: Integrate Shadcn components: Button, Input, Select, Card, Dialog, Tabs. Modify Shadcn defaults to use h-14 for inputs/buttons for thumb-friendly touch zones.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: For the KYC form, build a multi-step progressive wizard (Primary -> Co-borrower -> Guarantor -> Live Photo & GPS -> Submit). DO NOT dump all inputs on a single page. Use Tabs or custom step indicators.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Implement bilingual labels (e.g., 'Aadhaar Number / आधार संख्या') in all form fields.
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Do not use generic placeholder text or empty avatars. Use the provided image URLs where appropriate.
